theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 10 群

items.colloc: put out 拿出 | for display 供展示
items.distinct: showcase 櫥窗展示 | exhibit 展覽
ex: New products were put out for display in the lobby.
新產品已陳列在大廳供人參觀。
Please put out for display all the promotional items today.
請在今天把所有促銷品都陳列出來。
The team put out for display their latest design concepts.
團隊展示了他們最新的設計概念。

items.colloc: host a party 舉辦派對 | attend a party 參加派對
items.distinct: farewell party 歡送會 | reception 接待會
ex: We are organizing a retirement party for our director.
我們正在為部門主管籌備退休歡送會。
Everyone is invited to the retirement party this afternoon.
邀請各位參加今天下午的退休歡送會。
The retirement party will be held in the main conference room.
退休歡送會將在主會議室舉行。

items.colloc: break a record 打破紀錄 | current record 當前紀錄
items.distinct: make a record 錄音 | keep a record 紀錄存檔
ex: Our sales team managed to set a record this quarter.
我們的銷售團隊在本季創下了紀錄。
This new machine helped set a record for production speed.
這台新機器協助創下了生產速度的紀錄。
The company expects to set a record for annual profit.
公司預期將創下年度獲利紀錄。

items.colloc: take over the business 接管業務 | take over the project 接手專案
items.distinct: take on 承擔 | take up 佔用
ex: She will take over the marketing department starting next month.
她將從下個月起接管行銷部門。
Mr. Chen is going to take over as the project manager.
陳先生將接手擔任專案經理。
The multinational corporation decided to take over the local firm.
那家跨國公司決定接管當地的企業。

items.pos: phr. 逐步引導；詳細檢查
items.colloc: walk through the process 說明流程 | walk through the office 視察辦公室
items.distinct: go over 複習；審查 | look through 瀏覽
ex: Could you walk through the new system with me?
你可以帶我逐步了解這套新系統嗎？
The architect will walk through the construction site today.
建築師今天將會實地視察施工現場。
Let us walk through the contract clauses together tomorrow.
讓我們明天一起詳細審閱合約條款。

items.colloc: warm up the audience 炒熱氣氛 | warm up session 熱身階段
items.distinct: heat up 加熱 | cool down 冷卻
ex: The speaker tried to warm up the audience with a joke.
講者試圖用笑話來炒熱現場氣氛。
Please turn on the oven to warm up before baking.
烘烤前請先開啟烤箱進行預熱。
The team did some exercises to warm up before the meeting.
團隊在會議前做了一些運動來暖身。

items.colloc: keep a copy 留存一份 | send a copy 發送副本
items.distinct: an original 正本 | a duplicate 複製品
ex: Please submit a copy of your identification card.
請繳交一份您的身分證影本。
I have attached a copy of the report for your review.
我已附上一份報告供您審閱。
Every employee should have a copy of the handbook.
每位員工都應持有一份員工手冊。

items.colloc: a wide selection of 多樣選擇 | a careful selection of 精心挑選
items.distinct: a collection of 收藏品 | a range of 一系列範圍
ex: We offer a selection of wines for our guests to enjoy.
我們提供一系列精選紅酒供賓客享用。
The catalog features a selection of new summer outfits.
目錄中刊載了一系列夏季新款服飾。
There is a selection of snacks available in the lounge.
貴賓室提供一系列點心供選擇。

items.colloc: a variety of options 多種選擇 | a variety of tasks 各種任務
items.distinct: a range of 範圍內的 | a series of 一系列的
ex: The shop provides a variety of office supplies for us.
這家店為我們提供各式各樣的辦公用品。
We encountered a variety of issues during the implementation.
我們在執行期間遇到了各式各樣的問題。
The hotel offers a variety of services to its guests.
這家飯店為房客提供多樣化的服務。

items.colloc: address the public 向大眾演說 | keynote address 主題演講
items.distinct: give a speech 發表演講 | speak to the audience 向觀眾說話
ex: The CEO will address the audience at the annual conference.
執行長將在年會上向聽眾致詞。
It is time to address the audience about our goals.
現在是時候向聽眾說明我們的目標了。
The guest speaker stood up to address the audience.
客座講者站起來向聽眾發表演說。

items.colloc: provided at no charge 免費提供 | completely at no charge 完全免費
items.distinct: free of charge 免費 | for free 免費
ex: Replacement parts are provided at no charge under warranty.
保固期內的零件更換均為免費提供。
We offer technical support at no charge for our clients.
我們為客戶提供免費的技術支援。
The shuttle bus service is available at no charge.
接駁巴士服務為免費搭乘。

items.colloc: at no extra cost 無額外費用 | at no cost to you 對您零支出
items.distinct: at cost 按成本價 | low cost 低成本
ex: You can upgrade your subscription at no cost this month.
本月您可以免費升級您的訂閱服務。
The initial consultation is provided at no cost.
初步諮詢服務是免費提供的。
Training will be conducted at no cost to the employees.
培訓課程將對員工免費實施。

items.colloc: place on back order 列入缺貨清單 | item on back order 缺貨中的品項
items.distinct: out of stock 缺貨 | pending order 待處理訂單
ex: That specific model is currently on back order.
該特定型號目前處於延期交貨狀態。
We apologize that your item has been placed on back order.
我們很抱歉您的訂單目前缺貨待補。
Many customers canceled orders due to back order delays.
許多客戶因延期交貨而取消訂單。

items.colloc: be absent from work 缺勤 | be absent from the meeting 會議缺席
items.distinct: leave from 離開 | present at 出席
ex: He will be absent from the office for a week.
他將缺席辦公室一週。
Please notify HR if you will be absent from the training.
若您將缺席培訓，請務必通知人資部。
Several members were absent from the monthly planning meeting.
幾位成員缺席了月度規劃會議。

items.colloc: be allowed to enter 被准許進入 | be allowed to use 被准許使用
items.distinct: be permitted to do 被許可做 | be supposed to do 被期待做
ex: Staff members are allowed to work from home on Fridays.
員工被允許在週五遠端辦公。
You are not allowed to use personal phones during work.
工作期間您不被允許使用個人手機。
Only authorized personnel are allowed to enter the laboratory.
只有授權人員才被允許進入實驗室。

items.colloc: be in full agreement 完全同意 | reach an agreement 達成協議
items.distinct: agree with 同意某人 | agree on 同意某事
ex: The board members are in agreement regarding the budget.
董事會成員對於預算達成了一致共識。
We are all in agreement that the project should continue.
我們一致同意該專案應持續進行。
Are we in agreement about the revised schedule?
我們對於修訂後的時程表達成共識了嗎？

items.colloc: be responsible for the project 負責該專案 | be responsible for safety 負責安全
items.distinct: be in charge of 主管；掌管 | take responsibility 承擔責任
ex: Mr. Chen is responsible for the marketing budget.
陳先生負責行銷預算。
Who is responsible for checking these reports?
誰負責核對這些報告？
She is responsible for training new employees.
她負責訓練新進員工。

items.colloc: be lined with trees 兩側種滿樹木 | be lined with shops 排滿商店
items.distinct: lined up 排隊 | filled with 裝滿
ex: The main street is lined with many luxury boutiques.
主要街道的兩側排滿了許多高級精品店。
The office wall was lined with numerous awards and certificates.
辦公室的牆上排滿了各式獎項與證書。
The path is lined with colorful flowers for the event.
為了活動，小徑兩側種滿了鮮豔的花朵。

items.colloc: be mounted on the wall 安裝在牆上 | be mounted on a base 固定在底座
items.distinct: be attached to 附著在 | be placed on 放在…上
ex: The projector should be mounted on the ceiling firmly.
投影機應該穩固地安裝在天花板上。
New cameras are mounted on every corner of the building.
大樓的每個角落都安裝了新的攝影機。
The artwork is mounted on a piece of wooden board.
這件藝術品被鑲嵌在木板上。

items.colloc: highly qualified 高度稱職 | qualified for the position 職位稱職
items.distinct: be eligible for 有資格獲得 | be suitable for 適合
ex: She is definitely qualified for the senior marketing position.
她絕對有資格勝任資深行銷職位。
Not all applicants are qualified for this technical role.
並非所有申請者都具備這項技術職位的資格。
The candidate proved to be qualified for the new challenge.
該候選人證明自己有能力勝任這項新挑戰。
